decontamination_notes: Real uncaught-exception denial-of-service fix from validatorjs/validator.js PR #2822 ('isByteLength: handle unpaired UTF-16 surrogates'), merged 2026-07-25 -- after the training cutoffs of the models evaluated here (e.g. Opus 5, May 2026), so the specific fix is not in their training data (decontaminated: true), with upstream_merged recorded as proof. isByteLength() computed a string's UTF-8 byte length with `encodeURI(str).split(/%..|./).length - 1`. encodeURI throws a URIError on ANY unpaired UTF-16 surrogate, so a single lone surrogate in untrusted input crashes the validator and every caller that reaches it (e.g. isEmail) -- a DoS. The fix (src/lib/isByteLength.js) replaces the encodeURI trick with a manual byte count that treats a surrogate pair as 4 bytes and an unpaired surrogate as 3 (U+FFFD). validator.js is a zero-runtime-dependency package; its source uses extensionless ESM imports, so hidden tests run via tsx (node-ts image) and import the public default export. Repo sliced at the PR base commit (src/ tree, 6.1k LOC; isByteLength still using encodeURI); MIT LICENSE preserved. Coverage floor: 3 fail_to_pass (a lone high surrogate is 3 bytes; a lone low surrogate exceeds a 2-byte max; an ASCII char plus a lone surrogate is 4 bytes -- each throws URIError at base) plus a 2-check regression guard (a valid surrogate pair is 4 bytes; ASCII byte length is unaffected).

fail_to_pass.name: lone_high_surrogate
fail_to_pass.cmd: tsx --test --test-name-pattern='^vb lone high surrogate is measured as three bytes$' vb_bytelength.test.ts

fail_to_pass.name: lone_low_surrogate
fail_to_pass.cmd: tsx --test --test-name-pattern='^vb lone low surrogate exceeds a two-byte maximum$' vb_bytelength.test.ts

fail_to_pass.name: char_plus_surrogate
fail_to_pass.cmd: tsx --test --test-name-pattern='^vb ascii char plus lone surrogate is measured as four bytes$' vb_bytelength.test.ts

pass_to_pass.name: valid_pair
pass_to_pass.cmd: tsx --test --test-name-pattern='^vb valid surrogate pair is measured as four bytes$' vb_regression.test.ts

pass_to_pass.name: ascii_unaffected
pass_to_pass.cmd: tsx --test --test-name-pattern='^vb ascii byte length is unaffected$' vb_regression.test.ts
